title: Hand over a rejected message without handing over the card

cases.says: the log entry shows the request and the rejection field by field
the dump for the support desk is an image of the rejected request that the packager can read back
the messages go into the entry as ISOMsg objects, so the filter masks them; a wrapper that dumps them itself passes card data through
the bytes are text the filter never sees, so the card number is masked in what gets packed
the binary secrets are blanked too, not only the card number and track data
masking is done on a copy, so the client's own message keeps its real card data
card fields are masked rather than removed, so the dump keeps the host's lengths and bitmap

origin.section: 8.4 Bytes and Packager Traces Are Text Too
